notes: «حَدَّثَنِی مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِی مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارُ» : two men, each with his own «حدثني» (rule 7 counter-example), so two links
«حريز وفضيل» are co-transmitters of one level
the Imam sits inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator; the blessing is left out
